title: OFDM Equalizer
text: Equalize OFDM modulated signals, 3 inputs, 2 outputs; {Data format} sets the format of signals, {Algorithm} sets the equalization algorithm Minimum mean squared, {Noise variance source} sets the source of noise variance, {Noise variance}, {Output soft channel state information} enables soft channel state information and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Algorithm
params.values: Equalization algorithm Minimum mean squared error (default) | Zero-forcing

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: Source of noise variance Input port (default) | Property

params.name: Output soft channel state information
params.values: Enable soft channel state information output off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
